findings.note: Covers made a pick on Toronto's moneyline at -137 (best price then -146 at FanDuel), rating Toronto a 71% favorite, though it says the Leafs lost 8 of their past 9 with only middling 5v5 numbers (about 49.9% CF and xGF).

Toronto (8-11-2 in the snapshot) lists D Morgan Rielly out plus Sissons, Marchenko, Wood and Blankenburg on IR, and Bobrovsky has a .881 save pct. Chicago (5-13-1, 2.21 GF/G, 4.11 GA/G) lists only Byram on IR.
NHL.com reports Toronto lost all six games of its season-long homestand before this road game in Chicago. The Leafs return home Thursday to face the Kings.
